description: The catalog taxonomy: every category with its level (parent, primary, sub), product count, and storefront URL. The `category` filter of search_products accepts only PRIMARY-level names; parent and sub levels are for navigation and their `url`. `search_filter_value` is the exact value the `category` filter of search_products accepts, or null when the level is not filterable.

level.description: Only this taxonomy level. Omit for the whole tree (broadest level first).

name: list_categories

search_filter_value.description: The exact search_products `category` value; null below/above primary level

title: List SupplyClub categories
